full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media painted portrait brings a single front-facing face almost to the edges of the frame. A strong vertical seam runs down the middle from forehead through nose and mouth, dividing two different treatments of the same features. The left half is pale ochre and cream, with a large sharply described brown eye under a dark eyebrow. Angular white planes cut across the cheek and nose. The right half is deeper olive gray and umber, with a smaller, more shadowed eye, dark hair and a visible ear. The lips meet at the seam, their warm orange shape held against cooler patches below. At the bottom, a coral-orange garment spans both sides of the image. Large translucent gray-blue leaves and stems overlap the cheeks, throat and surrounding pale ground. Thin curving lines pass behind and across the head like pencil construction marks. The background remains largely off-white, allowing the two face colors and muted botanical shapes to appear suspended in a shallow plane. The eyes look directly outward, making the otherwise fragmented image feel steady. The left side is brighter, while a broad soft shadow fills much of the right. Subtle paper grain and watercolor-like washes are visible beneath more exact lines around the eyes and mouth. Edges vary from crisp at the central seam and brows to diffuse where leaves fade into the face. The composition is closely cropped and nearly symmetrical but unsettled by unequal scale and color. The whole portrait balances direct observation with layered transparent pattern, letting the divided tonal structure carry its tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介绘画肖像把一张正面面孔推得几乎贴到画幅边缘。一道强竖向接缝从额头经过鼻子与嘴唇，将同一组五官分成两种不同处理。左半边是浅赭和奶油色，一只大而清楚的棕眼位于深眉之下。棱角分明的白色平面切过脸颊和鼻梁。右半边是更深的橄榄灰与赭褐，眼睛较小且陷在阴影里，深发和耳朵可见。嘴唇在接缝处相接，暖橙形体停在下方较冷的色块上。底部珊瑚橙衣裳横跨图像两侧。大片半透明灰蓝叶子和茎覆盖脸颊、喉部及周围浅底。细曲线像铅笔打稿痕，在头部背后与前面穿行。背景主要保持灰白，使两种脸部颜色和低饱和植物形状悬在浅空间平面上。眼睛直视画外，让其他部分破碎的图像仍显稳定。左侧较亮，右侧大部分处在宽阔柔影中。细微纸张颗粒和近似水彩的薄洗色可见于眼口周围更精确的线条下。边缘从中央接缝及眉处的清晰度变化到叶形淡入面孔时的扩散感。构图紧贴裁切且几乎对称，却被不均等的尺度与颜色扰动。整幅肖像平衡了直接观察与透明层叠纹样，让分割的明暗结构承担张力。
style_prompt_en: The image has a layered mixed-media painting surface combining translucent washes, subtle paper grain and precise drawn accents. A central vertical split contrasts pale warm ochre and cream with deeper olive gray, umber and cool blue-gray. Broad planar overlays interrupt smooth modeling, so transparent shapes remain visible across denser areas. Thin curving lines add a light construction rhythm around the larger color masses. Edges are exact at key seams and dark accents but dissolve where washed layers overlap. Illumination is uneven yet softly spread, making one side markedly brighter while the other retains gentle shadow rather than harsh black. The space is extremely shallow and closely cropped, with visual depth created by transparency instead of perspective. Near symmetry gives the composition a stable axis, while mismatched scale, tone and layered shapes disturb it. A small warm lower band holds the arrangement together. The overall result is contemplative, tactile and subtly fractured, with the process of layering as visible as the finished form.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有层叠的混合媒介绘画表面，半透明洗色、细微纸张颗粒和准确描线结合。中央竖向分割让浅暖赭与奶油色，对照更深的橄榄灰、赭褐和冷蓝灰。宽阔平面覆盖层打断平滑塑形，使透明形状仍可穿过浓厚区域。细曲线在大色块周围添加轻巧的打稿节奏。关键接缝和深色强调处边缘准确，洗色层重叠时则逐渐溶解。照明不均却柔软铺开，一侧明显更亮，另一侧保留轻影而非硬黑。空间极浅且裁切紧密，视觉纵深来自透明叠层而不是透视。近似对称赋予构图稳定轴线，不匹配的尺度、色调和叠层形状又扰动它。下方一小道暖色把布局拢住。整体结果沉思、可触且轻微破碎，叠加过程与完成形态一样可见。
theme_en: A close front-facing face is divided into two differently colored halves over pale translucent leaf shapes
theme_zh: 一张近距离正面面孔被分成两种色彩的半边，叠在浅色半透明叶形之上
name: Francesco Clemente
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
